text:
sarah: Kicking off Rivermark POC thread — they want an MVP by end of Q2. Need to align on scope, success criteria, security asks, and pricing. Quick sync: who can join kickoff with customer tomorrow?
ajay: I can join. Need to confirm data flow and whether they want hosted API or private deployment. Also any sample prompts/evals we can run early? :mag:
jordan: Customer stakeholders: CTO (Liam), ML Lead (Priya), Platform Eng (Carlos), and Legal/Compliance. They prefer a short agenda: intro, goals, dataset access, success metrics, timeline, open Qs. 30–45 min.
marie: Heads up — if they require on-prem or VPC gen, we'll need network contact and expected egress patterns. Also ask if they need HSM/KMS for keys.
sarah: Good. For scope proposal I'm thinking: 1) extract+summarize use case (10k records/day), 2) assistant QA with company docs (RAG), 3) latency target <200ms tail for single-turn. Success criteria: precision on eval prompts > 85%, avg latency <200ms, cost target <$0.02/1000 tokens for test volume. Thoughts?
ajay: Those are reasonable. On evals: ask them for 50-100 labeled examples for initial evals. We can supply a small prompt set template. Example prompt format we test with:
```
User: "How do I reset my billing alert?"
Context: <doc snippets>
Assistant: <expected summary/step-by-step>
```

ajay: Also check model variant — we recommend quantized Llama2-70B for cost/quality tradeoff, but if they need lowest latency we can propose smaller 13B.
jordan: Legal will push for SOC2 and data retention terms. They've already sent an IR team questionnaire. I'll upload it to the shared drive and tag you.
sarah: Pricing Qs: for a 3-week POC with ~1M tokens total, do we propose hosted with trial credits or a short-term Dedicated reservation? Need quick estimate to include in POC SOW.
ajay: For 1M tokens hosted, ballpark invoice is tiny — we usually offer credits for POC. If they want predictability or private infra we should quote a short reserved seat for the POC (small GPU pool) — I'll estimate ~$3k/week for a minimal Dedicated setup (includes burst + SLOs).
marie: If Dedicated/private, they'll need firewall rules and a CIDR for peering. Also certificate pinning and our deploy bot will run a dry-run. @deploy-bot can you queue the checklist?
deploy-bot: [automated] POC private-deploy checklist created: network CIDR, kube-ops contact, KMS integration points, log retention settings. Link: https://intra.deploy/poctemplates/rvk
sarah: Discovery Qs to ask during kickoff (short list):
- Which model behavior matters most (conciseness vs. creativity)?
- Do you have non-public docs we need to ingest? Format (PDF, S3, DB)?
- Are there redaction/PII concerns and retention rules?
- Preferred deployment: hosted / dedicated / private?
- Success metrics: accuracy %, latency p90, cost per 1k tokens, error rate tolerance?
- Who signs off at the end (technical + business)?
ajay: Add: expected concurrency, seq length distribution, and prefix reuse (helps our batching recommendations). Also ask if they want function/tool-calling or structured output validation.
jordan: I'll send calendar invites for kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll include Liam, Priya, Carlos, Legal. We'll aim for 40 min and share pre-reads (SOW draft + security FAQ).
sarah: Pre-reads to attach: short SOW with scope & timeline, POC success criteria table, pricing options (hosted credits vs dedicated estimate), security checklist. I'll draft and share before EOD.
marie: One more ops note: collect sample logs and expected retention policy so we can size observability + any egress budgeting.
ajay: After kickoff, we should run a small initial eval (50 prompts) within 48 hours to surface major regressions. I'll prepare eval harness and a sample prompt pack.
sarah: Perfect. Action items:
- sarah: draft SOW + pricing (EOD)
- jordan: invite stakeholders & upload legal questionnaire
- ajay: prepare eval prompt pack and Dedicated cost estimate
- marie: prepare network/security checklist and required CIDR template
- deploy-bot: create private-deploy checklist link (done)

sarah: Thanks all — see you on the call. :thumbsup:
